name: Lights, Camera, Scandal!
source:
Lights Camera Scandal is a hit reality show where disgraced celebrities fight to restore their public image. Earn back the public's trust or be reaped by Riri, the Reaper of Stars, and say goodbye to the spotlight.

[From [url=https://chiselworks.itch.io/lightscamerascandal]itch.io[/url]]
